preRequisites:
1. Infras URL is accessible.
2. Valid user account exists in DB.
title: Verify Successful User Login with Valid Credentials to infras
description: Ensure that a registered user can log into the infras portal using valid email and password.
steps:
1. Navigate to infras login page.
2. Enter valid email address.
3. Enter valid password.
4. Click 'Sign In' button.
expectedResults:
1. User is successfully authenticated.
2. Redirected to Infras User Dashboard.
3. Welcome toast notification displayed.
